profile.headline: Software Engineer Sr at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Skilled design engineer with experience in working with aircraft manufacturers, providing layouts, drawings, and designs for aircraft. Adept in a range of design, engineering tools, and software packages. Knowledgeable and collaborative engineer that works with internal and client teams to provide solutions to manufacturing challenges.

positions.title: CAD/CAM Engineer Sr
positions.description:
* Subject Matter Expert (SME) for CAD Integration (CATIA V5, 3DX, Xcelerator) & PLM Processes.
 * Oversee CAD/CAM & PLM requirements for cross-functional teams.
 * Coordinate with IT to develop and deliver CAD/CAM & PLM tools.
 * Provide aerospace design expertise to support CAD/CAM & PLM capabilities.
 * Develop supporting documentation (methods, standards, processes, and training).
 * Validate tool and process requirements.
 * Deliver Engineering Dataset Standards, Methods, and updates to the Engineering Process Control Manual.
 * Support resolution of technical issues within the CAD/CAM & PLM environment.
 * Ensure successful project goals and program expectations are met.
 * Facilitate discussions and disseminate technical information.

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
Designed aircraft seats and components
•Worked on the CL3710 program
•Created bills of materials for aircraft seats and components and assemblies
•Created layout drawings for A350, B787 and B777
•Generated 2D drawings and 3D models for aircraft components and assemblies
•Created presentations outlining design direction and design issues.
•Supported and provided Purchasing and Production with necessary documentation
•Participated in design meetings with project engineers and platform leads to discuss engineering and design issues

positions.title: Help Desk Specialist
positions.description:
•Diagnosing and resolving technical hardware and software issues for Fidelity’s Enterprise Infrastructure
•Resolved a wide range of complex issues on a daily basis, across multiple systems with a high level of independency
•Achieved product and software mastery; handled inquiries from Fidelity’s representatives through
 inbound calls and chats.
•Assisted with the testing of software releases for desktop and mobile programs.
•Contributed to the improvement of multiple processes through weekly meetings 
with reps, managers and directors.

positions.title: Advanced Repair Agent
positions.description:
•	Engaged customers using selling skills to provide solutions aligning with their PC issues.
•	Work with the sales team, explaining services and technology to help them achieve business goals.
•	Providing fixes for a broad range of software for operating systems PC and Mac such as Microsoft office applications, update errors, malware infections, etc.
•	Promote teamwork amongst employees to reach goals.
•	Developed CAT5, CAT6, RJ45 connections for client’s networks.
•	Provided hardware installations such as router networks, PC setups, printers, etc.
•	Parts and inventory management.
